shortDirectoryDescription: MUGE PACKAGING is the brand of Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen-based custom packaging source factory for brand packaging projects. The company supports custom paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, folding cartons, paper tube packaging, PVC/PET clear boxes, corrugated boxes, cosmetic packaging and gift packaging. Buyers can review products and request a quote at https://mugepackaging.com.
certificationBoundary: MUGE PACKAGING is ISO 9001:2015 certified for the production of packaging products, including paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes, subject to the certificate scope and validity period.
